fields.Name: T122 - AI Overview Card Navigation
fields.Description: Verifies that clicking a navigation card on the AI Overview switches to that section's view.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) to land on the AI Overview. From the Overview, click one of the navigation cards (for example, Agents or Models) and confirm the UI switches to that section's view. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI Overview navigation cards were visible and one was clicked
The UI navigated to the corresponding AI section view (e.g. Agents or Models) and that section's content is displayed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
